设计意图： Mutation of avsi-002: shortened the size moving average window from 60 to 40 days to capture more recent size contraction trends while preserving the core value and size-trend interaction mechanism. The shorter window may improve responsiveness to recent size changes, potentially boosting IC and ICIR without changing the economic rationale.

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

cheapness = 1/pe_ttm; size_dev = (log(mkt_cap_float) - ts_mean(40, log(mkt_cap_float))) / ts_mean(40, log(mkt_cap_float)); signal = cheapness * -size_dev
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（DSL 算子链）

  1. 步骤1：divide(1, pe_ttm) → 除法：x ÷ y（分母为 0 时返回 0/NaN 保护）
  2. 步骤2：log(mkt_cap_float) → 计算自然对数（底数为e）
  3. 步骤3：log(mkt_cap_float) → 计算自然对数（底数为e）
  4. 步骤4：ts_mean(v3(log)) → 窗口 40 的滚动均值 (与m_avg相同)
  5. 步骤5：subtract(v2(log), v4(ts_mean)) → 减法：x - y
  6. 步骤6：log(mkt_cap_float) → 计算自然对数（底数为e）
  7. 步骤7：ts_mean(v6(log)) → 窗口 40 的滚动均值 (与m_avg相同)
  8. 步骤8：divide(v5(subtract), v7(ts_mean)) → 除法：x ÷ y（分母为 0 时返回 0/NaN 保护）
  9. 步骤9：neg(v8(divide)) → 返回-x
  10. 步骤10：multiply(v1(divide), v9(neg)) → 乘法：x × y

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
pe_ttm市盈率 TTM（估值字段）

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 pe：pe_ttm
  2. 计算 cheapness：1.0 / pe
  3. 计算 cheapness：cheapness.where(cheapness > 0, 空)
  4. 计算 size：np.log1p(mkt_cap_float.abs())
  5. 计算 size_ma：size.滚动窗口(40, min_periods=14).mean()
  6. 计算 size_dev：(size - size_ma) / size_ma
  7. 计算 signal：cheapness * (-size_dev)
  8. 计算 signal：signal

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_size_trend_value_short(df): df_copy = df.copy() pe = df_copy["pe_ttm"].replace(0, np.nan) cheapness = 1.0 / pe cheapness = cheapness.where(cheapness > 0, np.nan) size = np.log1p(df_copy["mkt_cap_float"].abs()) size_ma = size.rolling(40, min_periods=14).mean() size_dev = (size - size_ma) / size_ma.replace(0, np.nan) signal = cheapness * (-size_dev) signal = signal.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan) "kw">class="kw">return pd.Series(signal, index=df_copy.index, name="factor_size_trend_value_short")
